text: This might be a silly one so feel free to tell me I'm overthinking. We've had our foster son, 18 months, for a few weeks now and I'm still learning what's normal for him. Tonight his temperature is 38 exactly. He's been pointing at his throat and saying ow when he swallows, so I'm guessing it's sore, but he's still drinking his milk and water fine, just a bit slower. He's also got a few insect bites on his legs from the park yesterday which he keeps scratching, they're itchy little bumps, nothing else going on with them. He's absolutely wide awake, sat watching his cartoons and babbling at me, and earlier when he nodded off for a bit he woke up easy and was straight back to himself. I just don't have his history to go on yet and I don't want to get it wrong with a little one in my care. Anything I should be keeping an eye on overnight would be really appreciated.
